cause_quote: The commit that added refresh_base for prepared PRs set the binding's `base: pendingBase ? previous.base : structuredClone(pullRequest.base)` from GitHub PR details and integrated `commit: binding.base.commit`, never reading the live branch ref.
user_saw: A guest conversation continuing an existing PR reported its base as current after the target branch advanced, leaving the newer target files out of the workspace.
summary: Prepared-PR refresh_base (and preparation when the accepted base disagrees with PR metadata) now reads the live target branch SHA via readGitHubPublicationBaseSha instead of trusting lagging PR-detail base SHA.
reasoning: Refreshing a prepared PR's target branch was introduced hours earlier by 5cac93c15f2 (#190223), whose title says prepared PRs could not refresh before; it took the base commit from inspectOwnGitHubPullRequest PR details, which lag the branch ref. No other commit touched the preparation file between that commit and the fix, so the stale-base defect shipped with the feature.
